findings.desc: B-5952 CHK-001 edge/adversarial verification receipts do not execute the promised finite-bound mutations. The edge command merely checks JavaScript tautologies `c<=c` and `!((c+1)<=c)` after reading the constant; the adversarial command only greps the comparator and evaluates constant-false `804<=803`, so neither rebuilds/runs a ceiling+1, below-804, unbounded, relative-only, or warning-only mutant. The source/dist+doc receipt is also stored non-mechanical without an execution receipt. Independently, `pre_review_check_read {storyId:B-5952}` currently reports FAIL with PR_MUTATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING, PR_MUTATION_DID_NOT_BITE, PR_CONTROL_NOT_RESTORED, PR_TRANSCRIPT_MISSING, and PR_AUTHORITY_INADMISSIBLE. Replace the tautological probes with isolated executable mutations that first fail, restore the committed control, then pass, and record verifier-admissible receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:664-914 [high] CHK-001:adversarial:binding-scope-mutants does not prove the protected-document mutation returns nonzero as required. Its docRejected predicate is scoped.status!==0 OR combinedOutput.includes("violation"); the normal passing renderer prints "Scope gate: pass (... 0 unacknowledged violations)", so a status-0 control also satisfies the substring branch. The receipt can therefore report protectedDocRejected=true even if the mutation is not rejected, while F-002/F-003 resolutions overclaim a nonzero fail-closed proof. Parse --json and require status=fail/nonzero plus the exact protected path/rule, then restore bytes and require an explicit status=pass control before re-recording the receipt and resolutions.
findings.resolvedReason: The earlier immutable-pinned binding-scope receipt is not relied on for the document branch and its overclaim is explicitly superseded here. Output: binding-scope-mutants-v2 PASS sourceRejected=true distRejected=true docStatus=fail exactProtectedRule=true restored=true control=pass. The old pin cannot be silently rewritten in DEV, so strength is medium rather than strong.
